raw_html: [[Poison Burst#Poison Burst|Poison Burst]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Poison Burst#Poison Burst|Poison Burst]]:''' This weapon is dripping with poison, and deals 1 to 6 poison damage each hit. Critical hits deal an additional 1 to 10 poison damage for weapons with a x2 critical multiplier, 2 to 20 for a x3 multiplier and 3 to 30 for a x4 multiplier.
